items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: No, my style is strictly off of this fella in the quarter Archibald.

ctx.x: Did you have a teacher on the piano?

No, I never did. Can you read? Can't read, no. I used to go down to the quad and watch Archibald play the piano. Mm-hmm. And that's actually how I really learned how to play, watching him when I was about, oh, freshman in college. And then about a year, oh, about six months after I was in the college, four of us in the K fraternity, myself, had a little Dixieland band at that time. We played for about two years together under the name of the Audubon Street Four Plus One. And then eventually that broke up, and I…
Who was in the other band, the Audubon Street?
